newsitem.title: UK: All bets off, election is May - UK bookmakers.
newsitem.headline: All bets off, election is May - UK bookmakers.

text.p: British bookmakers William Hill said on Tuesday it would not take any more bets on the month when the election will be called.
Following the Conservative government's victory in a parliamentary vote on Monday, William Hill said May looks a certainty.
When it closed its book it was quoting May at 1-4, March at 7-2 and April at 5-1. The election must be held by May 22 and Labour leads the Conservatives by around 20 points in opinion polls.
